results.headline: Scancell Provides Corporate and Clinical Update
results.key_quote: The new data from the ongoing ModiFY trial, demonstrate that Modi-1 can induce vaccine-specific immune responses in a subset of patients with renal cell carcinoma (RCC), with these responses being associated with longer progression-free survival. These findings provide encouraging evidence of clinical activity of our Moditope platform and support further evaluation of Modi-1.
results.summary: Scancell reports positive clinical progress across its pipeline. Phase 2 ModiFY trial data show Modi-1 induces vaccine-specific immune responses associated with longer progression-free survival in RCC patients (6-month PFS 75% in responders vs 50% in non-responders, p=0.0025). Phase 2 SCOPE trial continues showing durable benefits with iSCIB1+ demonstrating superior 24-month OS at 87% and PFS at 71% compared to standard of care ipi/nivo at 41.5% PFS. FDA grants RMAT designation to iSCIB1+. Company states it is 'very encouraged by the progress' and results 'provide encouraging evidence of clinical activity'. Phase 3 iSCIB1+ trial remains on track for initiation December 2026 following FDA IND clearance and MHRA authorization. These represent clinical advances being presented positively against implicit benchmarks (standard of care comparisons and immunological endpoints).

iSCIB1+ 24-month PFS of 71% superior to standard of care ipi/nivo at 41.5%

FDA RMAT designation grant recognizing therapeutic potential
